description: The articles a project keeps as PDFs on its wiki pages — copied by their link or read with formulas: each file's id, name and page, where it was copied from and when (originUrl, fetchedAt), how many pages it has when known, and whether Mathpix's text with formulas is there ('recognized', with the pages read and billed), and viewUrl — the link that opens the file over its wiki page, to put in a comment or a page. Only files on pages you may read. Read the text with read_pdf_text, search inside it with search_pdf_texts.
